plugins.name: fiber
plugins.description: Search companies, find contacts, enrich data, and manage audiences using Fiber AI APIs. Provides MCP tools and skills for B2B data workflows.

plugins.name: fiber-ai
plugins.description: Search companies, find contacts, enrich data, and manage audiences using Fiber AI APIs

skills.name: audience
skills.description: Create and manage Fiber AI audiences for bulk operations — search, enrich, and export lists of companies or contacts at scale. Use when the user wants to build a prospecting list or do bulk data operations.
skills.description_zh: 创建和管理 Fiber AI 受众，批量搜索、补全和导出企业或联系人的名单，用于潜客名单及规模化数据操作。

skills.name: benchmark-vs-competitor
skills.description: Run a reproducible, pre-registered benchmark comparing Fiber AI to a competing data provider (People Data Labs, Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Coresignal, or any other API the user has credentials for) on the user's own sample. Reports honest side-by-side numbers including where Fiber underperformed. Use this when the user says "compare Fiber to <vendor>", "bake-off", "benchmark data quality", "which provider is better for my segment", "test data providers", "evaluate Fiber AI", or "should I switch from <vendor> to Fiber".
headings: Dimension 7: Agent tooling and documentation accessibility
Step 1: pre-register the benchmark (MANDATORY - do not skip)
skills.description_zh: 在用户自己的样本上开展预先登记且可复现的 Fiber AI 与其他数据提供方比较，支持有凭据的 People Data Labs、Apollo、Clearbit 等 API，并如实报告 Fiber 表现较差的项目；用于数据质量测试和供应商切换评估。

skills.name: build-recruiting-audience
skills.description: Build a recruiting-grade audience of candidates using Fiber AI - search, enrich work and personal emails, reveal phones, and export prospect CSVs. Use this when the user says "build a recruiting list", "find me candidates for role X at companies like Y", "talent audience", "recruiting audience", "sourcing list", "candidate outreach list", "recruiting prospect list", or otherwise asks for a saved, exportable list of people for hiring.
headings: Fiber AI: Build a Recruiting Audience
skills.description_zh: 使用 Fiber AI 搜索招聘候选人，补全工作与个人邮箱、获取电话并导出潜客 CSV，用于按岗位和企业建立可保存、导出的招聘联系名单。

skills.name: enrich-github-handles
skills.description: Resolve GitHub handles or profile URLs into LinkedIn profiles and full contact enrichment using Fiber AI. Use this when the user says "I have GitHub handles", "enrich these engineers by GitHub", "find LinkedIn for these GitHub users", "developer enrichment", "OSS contributors list", "dev candidate enrichment", or otherwise starts from GitHub identifiers and wants LinkedIn or contact data.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Fiber AI 将 GitHub 用户名或个人主页 URL 对应到 LinkedIn 档案，并补全联系资料；用于开发者、开源贡献者及技术候选人名单。

skills.name: enrich-linkedin-csv
skills.description: Enrich a list of LinkedIn URLs with work emails, personal emails, and phone numbers using Fiber AI. Use this when the user says "enrich these LinkedIn URLs", "I have a CSV of people", "bulk reveal emails for these profiles", "get contact info for this list", "decorate these contacts with phone/email", or otherwise hands over a set of LinkedIn identifiers and wants contact data back.
headings: Fiber AI: Enrich a List of LinkedIn URLs
skills.description_zh: 使用 Fiber AI 为一组 LinkedIn URL 或人员 CSV 批量补全工作邮箱、个人邮箱和电话号码。

skills.name: enrich
skills.description: Enrich companies or contacts with emails, phone numbers, and detailed profiles using Fiber AI. Use when the user wants to reveal contact information or get more details about a company or person.
headings: Person Profile Enrichment (full data, no field selector)
skills.description_zh: 使用 Fiber AI 为企业或联系人补全邮箱、电话和详细档案，用于获取联系信息或更多公司与个人资料。

skills.name: expand-from-email-list
skills.description: Turn a list of email addresses into full people + company records using Fiber AI reverse email lookup, then optionally pull fresh LinkedIn data and extra contact fields. Use this when the user says "I have emails, give me more info", "reverse lookup these emails", "I have a list of emails from our CRM", "decorate emails with LinkedIn/company", "who are these people (by email)?", "unknown customers enrichment", or otherwise starts from raw emails and wants identity + firmographic data back.
headings: Fiber AI: Expand From Email List
skills.name_hint: expand · from · 邮件 · 列举
skills.description_zh: 使用 Fiber AI 反向邮箱查询将邮箱名单扩展为人员和企业记录，再按需获取最新 LinkedIn 信息与更多联系字段；用于 CRM 邮箱补全或未知客户身份与企业特征查询。

skills.name: find-and-enrich-by-role
skills.description: Find prospects by role + company criteria and enrich a shortlist with contact details using Fiber AI. Use this when the user says "find VPs of Engineering at fintech startups", "CMOs at Series B SaaS", "heads of sales at X companies", "find me 20 CTOs in healthcare", "prospect by role + company", "sales target research", or otherwise wants to discover people by role and immediately get emails / phones back.
headings: Fiber AI: Find and Enrich By Role
skills.name_hint: 查找 · and · enrich · by · role
skills.description_zh: 按职位和公司条件使用 Fiber AI 找到潜客，再为短名单补全邮箱与电话；适用于如特定行业 CTO、某融资阶段 CMO 等岗位与企业组合筛选。

skills.name: find-similar-companies
skills.description: Find lookalike companies from one or more seed accounts using Fiber AI. Use this when the user says "find companies like <seed>", "competitors of <seed>", "similar to <seed>", "lookalike accounts", "companies that look like our best customers", "ABM lookalikes", "seed-based company search", or otherwise asks to expand a known account into a larger candidate list.
headings: Use the seed's signals as filters for the lookalike search
skills.description_zh: 从一个或多个种子客户出发，通过 Fiber AI 查找相似企业、竞争者或类似优质客户的账户，扩展 ABM 候选名单。

skills.name: help
skills.description: Show what Fiber AI can do and how to use it. Use when the user asks about Fiber AI capabilities, available commands, or needs general guidance.
skills.description_zh: 介绍 Fiber AI 的能力、可用命令及使用方法，为一般使用问题提供指导。

skills.name: quickstart
skills.description: Guided first-run experience that proves Fiber AI value in under 60 seconds. Verifies the API key, searches for companies in the user's industry, and reveals one contact - all in one flow. Use this when the user says "quickstart", "get started", "first run", "try Fiber", "show me what Fiber can do", "demo", "test Fiber", or has just installed the plugin and does not know where to start.
skills.description_zh: 为首次使用 Fiber AI 提供快速引导，验证 API 密钥、搜索用户行业的企业并获取一个联系人；原文目标是60秒内演示价值，适用于安装后的试用和演示。

skills.name: sdk-py
skills.description: Help writing Python code using the fiberai package. Use when the user wants to build a Python application, script, or automation that calls Fiber AI APIs programmatically.
skills.description_zh: 使用 fiberai Python 包编写以编程方式调用 Fiber AI API 的应用、脚本和自动化。

skills.name: sdk-ts
skills.description: Help writing TypeScript or JavaScript code using the @fiberai/sdk package. Use when the user wants to build an application, integration, or automation that calls Fiber AI APIs programmatically.
skills.description_zh: 使用 @fiberai/sdk 编写 TypeScript 或 JavaScript 应用、集成和自动化，程序化调用 Fiber AI API。

skills.name: search
skills.description: Search for companies or people using Fiber AI. Use when the user wants to find companies by criteria (location, industry, size, tech stack) or search for individual prospects.
headings: Natural-language search (when the user gives freeform prose)
skills.description_zh: 使用 Fiber AI 按地点、行业、规模、技术栈等条件搜索企业，或查找单个潜客。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Set up Fiber AI tools in the current environment. Use when the user needs to configure API keys, verify MCP connection, or install SDKs.
skills.description_zh: 在当前环境配置 Fiber AI 工具，包括 API 密钥设置、MCP 连接验证和 SDK 安装。

skills.name: track-signals
skills.description: Track buying and hiring signals on a seed list of people and companies - job changes (Journeyman), hiring intent (job postings), social activity (LinkedIn posts), and funding rounds - using Fiber AI. Use this when the user says "track signals", "watch these accounts for hiring intent", "alert me when these people change jobs", "monitor my ABM list", "job-change alerts", "who is hiring for <role> at <companies>", "recent posts from this exec", "recent funding at my targets", or otherwise wants to turn a static list into a live intent feed.
headings: B. Hiring intent signals (company-level, budget proxy)
C. Social / activity signals (person or company posts)
skills.description_zh: 通过 Fiber AI 跟踪种子人员与企业名单的购买和招聘信号，包括 Journeyman 职位变化、招聘岗位、LinkedIn 动态和融资轮次；用于 ABM 监控、跳槽提醒及将静态名单转为意向信息流。
